section_path: Anterior Surface of Epiglottis (excluding Malignant Melanoma)
text:
C101  Anterior surface of epiglottis

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Larynx,* pages 39-45.
* TNM includes lingual (anterior) surface of epiglottis (C101) with larynx 

**Note 2:**  Detailed descriptions of the anatomic limits of the structures of the epiglottis can be found in the Summary Stage Manual *Definition of Anatomic Sites Within the Head and Neck.*

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Tonsil, Oropharynx* chapter on page 60 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=60).
